description: This file provides a utility function `stripMarkdown` that removes lightweight markdown formatting from text, aiming to produce plain text suitable for Text-to-Speech (TTS) or channel fallback scenarios. The function uses regular expressions to handle various markdown syntax such as bold, italics, strikethrough, headers, blockquotes, horizontal rules, inline code, and multiple newlines.

methods.name: export function stripMarkdown(text: string): string { stripMarkdown
methods.description: Removes lightweight markdown formatting from the input text, returning plain text with minimal formatting preserved for readability and accessibility purposes.
